capabilities: create child notes with Luhmann-style ID filenames
create sibling notes with the next available ID
open notes by searching their first H1 title
insert links to notes found by title search
extras: The README is titled 'Luhmann' (spelled differently from the plugin id 'luhman') and lists three current maintainers, indicating the plugin has changed hands.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in commands for generating hierarchical Luhmann-style IDs as filenames or for finding notes by their inner H1 title rather than filename.
summary: Command set for running a Luhmann-style zettelkasten, creating notes with ID-based filenames and opening or linking notes by their first H1 title.
